observations: Root cause of the tester red was NOT semantic: `human.question=` etc. fail graphviz lexing purely because of the dot in the attribute NAME — quoting the name (`"human.question"=…`) is standard DOT and parses; both graphs now green under dot -Tcanon.

Engine-side acceptance of quoted DOT attribute IDs is unverified: the `fabro` binary is not installed in this sandbox (qualitygate's fabro-validate fallback arm also unreachable), so `dot -Tcanon` is the only parser that exercised the fix; quoted IDs are standard DOT so risk is low but the next live conductor run is the real probe.
